source.title: Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 8 June 1967, p. 14 ("Notice of Result of Elections: election of rural district councillors (Ballymena), 1967")
source.publisher: Ballymena Weekly Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: sole candidate, entered as elected in the returning officer's notice with no votes recorded (Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 8 June 1967, p. 14, image-read)

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. The Galgorm division was the only contest; the other divisions were filled unopposed. The Longmore return, not legible in the Ballymena Observer's printing of the notice, is taken from the same notice in the Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 8 June 1967, p. 14. Returned unopposed.
